articles.title: Meet Amit Kshatriya: Indian American named Nasa's associate administrator
articles.description: Indian American Amit Kshatriya, a 20-year Nasa veteran, has been named associate administrator, the agency’s top civil service post. He will guide Artemis Moon missions and Nasa's Mars ambitions under Trump’s term.
